room_description: A recreational games room with a pool table, dartboard, arcade machine, and retro gaming decor.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the games room.
Finding a metal slider piece under the billiard balls on the pool table.
Examining a row of cues and colored billiard balls on the wall rack.
Opening a toy chest using a 4-digit code (2571) to find a box cutter.
Using the box cutter to open a stuffed cow toy to find a silver coin.
Inserting the coin into the arcade machine to play a mini-game.
Playing a directional arrow game on the arcade screen.
Revealing the code '495' in Red, Green, and Blue ink on the arcade screen.
Entering '950' (based on color logic) into a wall safe hidden behind the dartboard.
Retrieving the exit key from the wall safe.

solution_steps: Count the billiard balls of different colors on the rack.
Check the dartboard for specific numbers hit by darts.
Combine these counts to derive the code 2571 for the chest.
Insert the coin to start the game.
Press the arrows (Left, Up, Right, Down) in the sequence indicated by the flashing characters on screen.

final_action: Using the key found in the wall safe to unlock the wooden exit door.
